description:
Database client for SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite and DuckDB

Native Windows database client: SQL editor with completion, result grids, query history, execution plans, server monitoring, backups and schema comparison. Passwords stay in a local encrypted vault. Ships a command-line client (dbc.exe) and an MCP server for AI tools (dbc-mcp.exe). The user interface is in Czech. The app updates itself from GitHub Releases.
